purpose: Offline tests against the exact upstream Paseo 0.11.2 websocket server; never loaded by the plugin at runtime and not part of any install
source: registry tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/@getpaseo/server/-/server-0.11.2.tgz; the file is copied unmodified and only gzip-compressed (gzip -9 -n)
integrityCheckedAgainst: runtime/package-lock.json (npm ci installs exactly this tarball); the sha512 of the registry tarball this file was taken from equals it

license.declared: MIT (README of the 0.11.2 package; the tarball has no LICENSE file and no license field)
license.later releases: 0.16.x and 0.17.x declare Apache-2.0 and ship its text; nothing from them is vendored here
